# TalvBot — gacha capsules on BNB Chain

TalvBot is a robot-run gacha capsule machine. Supply: 999 capsule NFTs, one
pool shared by free and paid spins. One spin = one capsule, tier revealed in
the mint transaction. Every 100th paid spin wins 0.025 BNB, paid instantly in
the same transaction. There is no claim step anywhere in this project.

## Facts
- Contract: 0xB33E2f4189C9171E6572b81e13091Ccc0F595483, BNB Chain (56)
- Paid spin: spin() with value == currentPrice() — steps 0.0008 / 0.0010 /
  0.0012 / 0.0015 BNB as supply fills. Quote currentPrice() first, always.
- Free spin: freeSpin(), once per wallet, Binance Agent ID holders only
  (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Common/Rare only.
- Tiers (paid): Common 62%, Rare 30%, Legendary 8%. Max 25 spins per wallet.
- Jackpot: paid spins #100, #200, ... #900 pay 0.025 BNB to the spinner in the
  same transaction. Free spins do not count toward the jackpot.

## Agent prompt (copy-paste)
"You are my TalvBot agent on BNB Chain. Contract: 0xB33E2f4189C9171E6572b81e13091Ccc0F595483.
Standing order: (1) read mintOpen(), totalMinted(), currentPrice(),
paidSpinsToJackpot() and spinsOf(my wallet) — never assume the price.
(2) If my free spin is unused and my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID, call
freeSpin() once (0 BNB). (3) Paid spins are purchases: call spin() with value
exactly equal to currentPrice(), one spin per transaction, ONLY up to the spin
budget I set for you; if I set no budget, buy nothing and report OPERATOR: SET
SPIN BUDGET. (4) After each spin, read the Spun event and record tokenId, tier
and jackpotWei — a jackpot is already paid, nothing needs claiming.
(5) Report every run: spins today, tiers won, jackpot won, BNB spent, wallet
BNB balance, capsules left, paid spins to next jackpot. If the wallet cannot
cover price + gas, report OPERATOR: TOP UP SPIN WALLET. Keep ~0.002 BNB as a
gas buffer above the budget."
